purpose: Recent singles competition footage for testing pose detection, not model-generated demonstrations or training ground truth.
selection_method: Manually inspected and trimmed for test inputs; these are not automatically ranked highlights.

event.name: 2026 YONEX Arise International Challenge
event.tier: BWF International Challenge, a world-ranking tournament; not the World Championships or a World Tour Super 1000.

attribution.creator: Arise Sports Complex
attribution.source_title: 2026 YONEX Arise International Challenge | Day 3 - Court 1 | Quarter Finals
attribution.changes: Recorded accessible 1080p playback, removed audio, trimmed continuous sections, and encoded H.264 MP4 at 30 fps. No crop, zoom, slow motion, text, skeleton, or AI frame interpolation.
attribution.endorsement: No endorsement by the venue, players, tournament, or BWF is implied.

limitations: These are browser playback recordings, not bit-for-bit downloads of the original upload.

Capture timing is variable. The 30 fps export can repeat or drop a frame when normalizing timing; it does not add genuine detail. This is not pristine 60 fps footage for fine-grained biomechanics or high-quality slow motion.
Source timestamps are approximate links for navigation, not frame-exact ground truth.
The match on the center court is singles, but adjacent courts and spectators add other people to the image. Limit analysis to the center court.
No audio is included. These clips test visual analysis, not sound-based hit detection.
No pose or shuttle model has been run on these inputs.
